claims.claim: Reset semigroup satisfies O(1,16 D^2;1/4) on any bounded metric probability space
claims.basis: Elementary explicit coupling and AM–GM proof
claims.scope_limit: No diffusion or intrinsic-metric assumption; all distinct x,y and all times in the stated closed horizon.

claims.claim: Reset generator has optimal BE curvature K_N=1-4/N for finite N and K_infinity=1 on atomless probability spaces
claims.basis: Exact Gamma calculus and arbitrarily small positive-measure set witnesses
claims.scope_limit: Same-curvature no-finite-N conclusion at K=1 only; lower curvature has finite N.

claims.claim: No finite Hausdorff-dimension bound from fixed O-data (1,16,1/4) in the broad reversible Feller Markov class
claims.basis: Normalized cubes, plus an explicit compact infinite-dimensional Hilbert cube
claims.scope_limit: The Markov generator is nonlocal and noncanonical.

claims.claim: Finite-dimensional canonical heat-flow W2 bound implies O(K,2N exp(KT);T)
claims.basis: Authored elementary deduction from EKS v2 Theorem 3 / Proposition 2.22 or Kuwada (1.4)
claims.scope_limit: Conditional on cited finite-dimensional heat-flow hypotheses; not a reverse equivalence or an attained sharp coefficient.

claims.claim: Exact time/metric scaling rules for transport constants and BE parameters
claims.scope_limit: Raw constants need normalization; this does not preclude normalized relations.

claims.claim: Euclidean Brownian coefficient bracket n-1 <= C* <= n, and C*>0 in dimension one
claims.basis: Gaussian covariance calculation and justified local Taylor expansion
claims.scope_limit: Zero curvature; no exact optimum or sharp positive-curvature claim.

claims.claim: OU BE(lambda,infinity) and equal-time contraction do not imply a finite uniform unequal-time coefficient
claims.basis: Explicit Gaussian transition mean and generator computation
claims.scope_limit: Unbounded base space; finite-dimensional BE hypothesis is absent.

independent_audit_status: Required before publication; no audit result claimed in author freeze
